user.title: Siemens S7 PLC
user.description: Enter your PLC connection details. Tags use PLC4X syntax ('DB1.DBD0:REAL', 'M10.5:BOOL') or nodeS7 syntax ('DB1,R0', 'M10.5', 'IW22'); separate multiple tags with newlines or semicolons. On S7-1200/1500, data blocks must have 'Optimized block access' turned off.

data_description.protocol: Legacy: classic S7 (PUT/GET) for S7-300/400 and S7-1200/1500 with PUT/GET enabled. S7CommPlus: S7-1200/1500 where PUT/GET is disabled.
data_description.rack: Used by the legacy protocol only.
data_description.slot: Used by the legacy protocol only.
data_description.tags: One address per line (or separated by semicolons).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the PLC. Check host, port, protocol and rack/slot. On S7-1200/1500 the legacy protocol needs PUT/GET to be permitted.
error.cannot_read_tag: Connected to the PLC, but could not read: {tag}. Check that the address exists and the data block is long enough. On S7-1200/1500 the data block must have 'Optimized block access' turned off.
error.invalid_tags: One or more tag addresses could not be parsed, or are arrays (not supported). Check the syntax.

data_description.tags: One address per line (or separated by semicolons). The tags are read once before saving. Saving reloads the integration and deletes entities of removed tags.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the PLC to check the tags, so nothing was saved.
error.cannot_read_tag: Connected to the PLC, but could not read: {tag}. Check that the address exists and the data block is long enough. On S7-1200/1500 the data block must have 'Optimized block access' turned off.
error.invalid_tags: One or more tag addresses could not be parsed, or are arrays (not supported). Check the syntax.

write_tag.name: Write tag
write_tag.description: Write a value to a PLC tag.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value to write, converted to the tag's datatype: true/false for BOOL, a whole number for integer types, any number for REAL and LREAL, text as typed for string types.

pulse_tag.name: Pulse tag
pulse_tag.description: Write True, wait, write False — for momentary bit commands.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: BOOL tag address (PLC4X or nodeS7 syntax).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold True before resetting, in seconds.
